profile.role_note: Works as either an on-field Basic Attack carry or an off-field Unison buffer. Pre-release: not yet launched (Phase 2).

pull_verdict.verdict: If you pulled Hsin, Suoming is her best partner and a strong pull. Everyone else should wait for launch-day numbers before deciding.

build.fast_path: Fast path: Unspoken Rue (or Emerald of Genesis / a Crit sword) + 5-piece Heart of Sworn Vigil in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout. Crit DMG 4-cost, Electro DMG 3-costs, ATK% 1-costs. Level her Forte Circuit first. Pre-release: multipliers can still change.

ranked_weapons.name: Unspoken Rue
ranked_weapons.note: 588 ATK, 24.3% Crit Rate substat. Interacts with her Unison mechanics for both her personal damage and her support role. Confirmed by name in the 3.7 broadcast.

ranked_weapons.name: Red Spring
ranked_weapons.note: identical 588 ATK / 24.3% Crit Rate stats and boosts normal attack strings; the best alternative for extended on-field windows.

ranked_weapons.name: Emerald of Genesis
ranked_weapons.note: 24.3% Crit Rate, ATK boosts, plus Energy Regen that eases Echo stat requirements. Widely owned and dependable.

ranked_weapons.name: Unflickering Valor
ranked_weapons.note: 413 ATK, 77.04% Energy Regen, +8% Crit Rate passive; its Liberation-triggered Basic Attack DMG bonus feeds the same combo that builds her Delusion gauge.

ranked_weapons.name: Lumingloss / Commando of Conviction
ranked_weapons.note: free-to-play options that buff Basic Attack DMG after a Resonance Skill cast, matching her natural combat cadence. Workable while farming better pieces.

echo_sets.name: Heart of Sworn Vigil
echo_sets.note: 2-pc: +10% Electro DMG. 5-pc: +15% Crit Rate and +22.5% Electro DMG for 30s when she inflicts Electro Flare, gains Unison, or triggers a Unison Response. She triggers these in both modes, so the set stays live through either playstyle. Consensus 3-costs are Formrender and Soulfrayer; 1-costs are Kernel Puppet: Joy and Fog Lionarch: Body.

echo_sets.name: Flash of Electric Reflection
echo_sets.note: If run purely as Hsin's buffer. Theorycraft disagrees on whether she applies Electro Flare reliably — don't farm this first.

stat_priorities.note: Crit DMG if running her signature or another Crit sword (weapon plus ascension bonuses supply plenty of Crit Rate); Crit Rate if substats lack it.
Electro DMG Bonus on both is the default across every source.

substat_priority: Basic Attack DMG / ATK% (sources differ on order — both are close)
build.energy_regen_target: Enough for Liberation every Deep Mind cycle; comfort, not the main stat chase

teams.name: Premium: Hsin / Suoming / Shorekeeper (Unison quick-swap)

members.name: Hsin
members.note: The Electro hypercarry. Takes the field during the Unison window and spends it on her Resonance Skill burst, amplified by Suoming's buffs.

members.name: Suoming
members.note: The engine of the team. Builds her Delusion gauge in Deep Mind, fires her Liberation to gain Unison, then swaps out — handing Hsin Electro DMG and Resonance Skill DMG amplification while her Thunder Crest coordinated attacks keep striking.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Heals and hands out Crit buffs while barely needing field time, so she never breaks the Hsin-Suoming swap rhythm. (Suisui can sub in with healing plus Electro Flare support.)

teams.rotation: Shorekeeper opens with buffs and healing, then Suoming enters via her Intro Skill, builds Delusion, and casts Liberation for Unison. Swap to Hsin immediately — her Outro and the free Intro fire without spending Concerto Energy. Play Hsin's window under the buffs, then swap back when Hsin holds Unison to trigger a Unison Response, and repeat. Pre-release theorycraft — unconfirmed until launch.

teams.name: On-field carry: Suoming / Sanhua / Shorekeeper (no Hsin)

members.name: Suoming
members.note: The on-field carry. Spends Unison on Seal Master instead of handing it away — nearly all her damage in this window counts as Basic Attack DMG.

members.name: Sanhua
members.note: The key partner: her Outro Skill boosts Basic Attack DMG for the incoming character, covering Suoming's enhanced Basic Attacks and Whirling Thunder. A cheap 4-star.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Keeps the team alive and boosts Suoming's Crit stats, making the long on-field window more forgiving to play.

teams.rotation: Sanhua opens to apply her Outro buff, Shorekeeper refreshes heals and buffs, then Suoming takes the field for the long haul — Liberation into Rift Cleaver into Seal Master, then her enhanced attack string. Don't swap her out mid-window; her damage is all in the uninterrupted barrage.

teams.name: Budget: Suoming / Sanhua / Verina (F2P-friendly)

members.name: Suoming
members.note: Identical on-field Seal Master carry role — she is still the carry, spending Unison on her own Basic-Attack window.

members.name: Sanhua
members.note: Same Outro Basic Attack buff duty; free from the login event, so most accounts have her.

members.name: Verina
members.note: The standard-pool healer — pickable from the Beginner's Choice Convene — who heals and buffs team damage with short field time. Baizhi works as the fully free alternative.

teams.rotation: Identical to the on-field team: Sanhua buffs, Verina heals and buffs, Suoming stays on-field through her window. You lose Shorekeeper's Crit buffs, so expect a lower ceiling, but the core loop is intact and costs almost nothing beyond Suoming herself.
